representation_pattern.use: Represent a RelationVersion and each RoleParticipation as identified resources, preserving participant version, role, and slotOrdinal; do not replace n-ary role incidence with a pairwise clique.
representation_pattern.limit: The Note supplies no HSWM semantic-weight, joint-distribution, ownership, permission, or learning semantics.

experiment_contract_boundary.joint_predictions: No selected standard defines the intended joint candidate semantics. Record CandidateSet version, ordered candidate identities, joint outcome law/constraint, and exact evaluation interpretation in a local typed protocol.
experiment_contract_boundary.outcome_bound_updates: Use PROV links to locate the exact Prediction, Outcome, RevisionProposal, CommittedRevision, and fresh execution; the causal estimand, sham/remove/restore conditions, and no-change classification remain local protocol requirements.
experiment_contract_boundary.equal_budget: No selected standard certifies a fair comparison. Predeclare and observe model/checkpoint, tokenizer, server/build, generation configuration, input/output token counts, request count, read-set bytes, repeats, wall time, failures, and any explicit compute-budget factor. Identical provenance shape does not imply equal information or cost.
